approach: Static PPU/SPU recompilation to native Windows x64 C++, with a PS3 HLE runtime using Direct3D 12 and WASAPI.
notes: Playable from start to finish on Windows x64. Features native Direct3D 12 rendering, FSR1 upscaling, keyboard/mouse and gamepad controls, Sixaxis steering, and a bilingual launcher and installer. Based on the European PS3 release BLES00758. Development continues on battle performance, audio stability and compatibility.
